name: AI Playground
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Try out the AI agents on your computer, a test per tab: play chess against Claude Code, Codex, Hermes or Pi (or let two agents play each other), compare speed and cost, judge two answers blind, test vision with a picture, screenshot or video frames, and ask your local LLMs with tokens per second. Goes with AI Agents Map. 8 languages.
